title: Your own cluster or a managed one: the arithmetic that decides

videos.script: Lesson 6 read the price lists: a managed control plane costs about ten cents an hour. Lesson 47 will build one by hand. This lesson puts the two side by side. {{both}} The fee is easy to compare, and it is the wrong thing to compare. The machines cost the same either way, and the real difference is in hours: who upgrades the cluster three times a year, who restores etcd, who renews the certificates. {{hours}} You will do the arithmetic with the numbers this course has measured, and with your own numbers where it has none. {{arithmetic}} And then the cases where running your own still wins. {{wins}}
